name: Barbwire & Lace
description: A 3.5-acre vintage reception venue with mountain views, indoor and outdoor spaces, gardens, fairy lights, rustic and antique character, and an open-air barn with a fireplace.
priceText: Do It Yourself package $3,000; All Access package $4,500

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Do It Yourself — $3,000: 6-hour time block (choose the hours), 1 hour setup on event day, exclusive use of allotted outdoor areas, open-air barn dance-floor pavilion with working fireplace, seating for up to 100, 10 round tables with choice of centerpieces, whiskey barrel cake table, 3 banquet tables, onsite kitchen, separate bride and groom suites, gift room, sound system with microphone, 2.5 acres of parking
DIY add-ons: vine-covered ceremony area $750, indoor loft with walkout balcony $750, table and chair setup/takedown $400, 50 sparklers $25, saloon for stations or non-alcoholic drinks $200, Decor Store station pieces $100+ each
All Access (Done For You) — $4,500: 8-hour time block, 1 hour setup day of or night before, exclusive use of all indoor and outdoor areas, seating for up to 200, 10 round tables with centerpieces and linens, choice of cake table, ceremony area, loft, setup/takedown, 50 sparklers, saloon and unlimited Decor Store stations included
Additional sparklers — $0.50 each
Photo shoot with an outside photographer — $75 for 1 hour 30 minutes
